If `record_for_host(url)` returns nil, `category` will be nil and there is no longer an explicit fallback to the prior configured `embed_category`. However, the diff also changes host validation to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` (e.g., lib/topic_retriever.rb, app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which may prevent imports for unlisted hosts, so the claimed behavior is an edge-case/robustness concern rather than a clearly verifiable defect from this diff alone.
